title: IIMJobs Scraper Input
description: Configure the IIMJobs scraper to extract job listings from any category or keyword page on iimjobs.com.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: The iimjobs.com listing page URL to scrape. Use any category page like https://www.iimjobs.com/k/finance-and-accounts-jobs or keyword page like https://www.iimjobs.com/k/data-science-jobs.

maxPages.title: Max Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of listing pages to scrape. Each page contains ~50 jobs. Set to 1 for a quick test or up to 100 for a full scrape.
